messages:
cs-ops: BrightCart (paid) reporting sudden surge of 5xx for their hosted API key starting 2024-11-09T08:28Z. Customer sees ~40% 5xx, many 503s. They are on a call now and provided a sample request + timeframe.

mike: pinging eng oncall, please include model, pool, and whether they use toolcalls or long concatenations.

eva: model=redwood/gpt-7b-quant-v2, pool=hosted-us-west-2-a. Window 2024-11-09T08:27:30Z -> 08:35:20Z. They run a toolchain that does nested toolcalls + an embedding in the middle; observed many concurrent requests.

ashley: node watchdog shows repeated GPU memory pressure then process exits. Snippet from node logs:
```
[2024-11-09T08:30:12Z] infer-runner[pid=4112]: nvml: memory allocation failed: out of memory
[2024-11-09T08:30:12Z] infer-runner[pid=4112]: aborting: SIGSEGV in fused_matmul_kernel
[2024-11-09T08:30:12Z] kernel: coredump written /var/crash/infer-runner.4112.core
```

laura: runtime metrics show kv-prefetch map unexpectedly ballooned (per-pod map >1M entries) after repeated concatenation from the customer's toolchain. Average sequence lengths per request ~9k-12k tokens; several requests end up >50k combined. Eviction code appears to hit while prefetching which leads to a crash in a JIT-compiled kernel.

mike: immediate mitigations we should push: 1) throttle the key (max_concurrency=2, qps=8); 2) route them to cpu-fallback-us-west for stability; 3) add gateway fast-fail for token_estimate > 40k for hosted GPU pools.

cs-ops: customer approved reroute and throttling. Applying route: `/routing set --key brightcart --fallback=cpu-fallback-us-west --max_concurrency=2 --qps=8`

deploy-bot: routing update applied for key=brightcart at 2024-11-09T08:33:10Z by cs-ops

paul: rolling back the small kv-prefetch heuristics canary from 2024-11-09T02:07Z (commit c9d4ef) to eliminate any heuristic-induced kernel selection changes. Starting rollback.

deploy-bot: rollback job started rollback-to=c9d4ef ETA 3m

ashley: while rollback runs please collect artifacts: cores, nvidia-smi snapshots, and previous pod logs. Suggested commands:
```
kubectl -n hosted logs infer-runner-<pod> --previous > /tmp/log.prev
sudo gcore -o /tmp/core.$(date +%s) <pid> || true
nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,used_memory --format=csv > /tmp/nvml-mem.csv\``` 

eva: uploaded two core dumps and nvml snapshots to INC ticket. Stack shows crash inside jit_compiled fused attention kernel (jit_kernel.cu) called from attention forward path.

laura: eng repro notes: created a synthetic toolchain that returns large outputs (tool A ~30k tokens) then an embed call (~5k) then tool B (~20k) -> total ~55k tokens. On a dev A100 with batch 6 and kv-prefetch enabled we reproducibly hit OOM then SIGSEGV at ~55k combined tokens. Disabling kv-prefetch avoids the segfault (memory usage high but stable).

mike: repro steps for infra/eng:
1) craft long-toolcall payload (concatenate tool outputs to reach 50-60k tokens).
2) POST to `/v1/generate` with model `redwood/gpt-7b-quant-v2`, stream=false, prefetch enabled, batch=6.
Example curl:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood-hosted.com/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $BRIGHTCART_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/gpt-7b-quant-v2","input":"<very long concatenated tool output>","stream":false}'
```

paul: created ENG-1298 to add bounds checks in kv-prefetch eviction, harden JIT kernel entry checks, and add an integration regression for chained toolcall+embed patterns. Assigned to laura/ashley and marked P0 for hotfix.

mike: short term plan: keep BrightCart on CPU fallback for 60m, deploy gateway token-estimate guard for GPU pools, add per-key prefetch map threshold to fast-fail, and roll a canary that disables prefetch for their key only.

cs-ops: BrightCart accepted a 10% service credit for the impacted window. CS to follow up once a canary is stable before routing them back.

laura: postmortem notes: add an eval case that simulates nested toolcalls + embed combos; correlate by api_key and include a KV-map growth monitor that can alarm before OOM. Also include test coverage for JIT kernel eviction safety.

support-bot: incident INC-20241109-87 created severity=high owner=mike

mike: thanks all 1: collecting artifacts and will brief the customer after we verify the canary. Next update in 30m or earlier if rollback surfaces additional crashes.

cs-ops: on-call bridge open; customer is waiting for canary. We'll close the bridge in 20m if no regressions.
